quant-1259-4465.title: Bridging dual representation and spectral risk measure through scoring function
quant-1259-4465.abstract: dual representation and spectral risk measure are both active topics in Quant, yet no paper in our corpus has studied them together. Both are already linked to 84 common concepts, including scoring function, minimizer and dynamic risk measure, which suggests the methods and data needed to connect them already exist. We propose a study that uses scoring function as a bridge: first, review how dual representation and spectral risk measure are each currently treated through scoring function; second, design an approach that combines them and test it on established benchmarks from both lines of work; third, measure whether the combination improves on each topic studied alone. We expect the work to clarify where the two literatures overlap and to open a new line of research between them.
